test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Carrots have a high content of vitamin A. How does eating carrots help a child?

options.text: It will make the child's bones strong.
It will strengthen the child's vision.
It will give the child a good amount of energy.
It will help the child resist many diseases.

solution:
The correct option is *'it will strengthen the child's vision'*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carrots **are rich in **beta-carotene,** which the body converts into **vitamin A**.
